jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.location: Bangalore - Manyata Tech Park Road · India
jobs.description: Organization: At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. Job Title: Staff Software Engineer Location: Bangalore-Manyata Tech Park Impact & Contribution: We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer with strong hands-on engineering and architecture experience across Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and cloud-native platforms, complemented by expertise in Pega and enterprise workflow/case management solutions. You will play a key technical leadership role in designing and modernising large-scale applications, building resilient services and integration capabilities, and evolving our platforms towards modern cloud-native architectures. The ideal candidate brings a strong software engineering and product mindset, is comfortable working across Java-based services and Pega applications, and can make pragmatic architectural decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data, cloud and workflow platforms. Knowledge of AI fundamentals, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions is highly regarded. As a Staff Engineer, you will remain hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and influencing engineering standards and architecture across teams. Roles & Responsibilities: Lead the architecture, design and delivery of Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and Pega solutions , ensuring scalable, resilient, secure and maintainable enterprise applications. Drive application modernisation and cloud-native engineering, including legacy decomposition, API enablement, AWS migration, containers/Kubernetes/ECS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and DevSecOps. Define architectural boundaries and integration patterns across Pega, Java services, enterprise platforms and external systems, determining when capabilities should be implemented in Pega versus custom services. Establish and champion strong engineering practices covering clean code, API design, automated testing, security, observability, performance, production readiness, code/design reviews and troubleshooting. Provide technical leadership and mentoring across engineering teams, collaborate with product and architecture stakeholders, and enable appropriate adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within enterprise applications. Essential Skills: 12–18 years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex enterprise platforms and architecture-level decision-making. Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices and distributed systems, including RESTful APIs, enterprise integration, concurrency, resiliency, scalability, performance and troubleshooting. Strong experience with relational/NoSQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, along with authentication and application security including OAuth2, JWT and OWASP principles. Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native engineering, including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager and CloudWatch, as well as Docker and Kubernetes. Strong experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps and infrastructure automation, including GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Terraform/CDK, automated testing, code quality, secrets management and production observability. Hands-on experience designing and delivering Pega enterprise applications, with strong knowledge of case management, workflows, data/integration patterns, security, performance and application architecture; Pega LSA or equivalent architecture-level experience is highly regarded. Experience with modern Pega capabilities, including Constellation, Blueprint, App Signature and Pega GenAI features, is highly regarded. Ability to make architecture decisions across custom Java development, APIs/microservices and Pega low-code capabilities, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem; TypeScript and modern front-end experience is desirable. Knowledge of AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures, with exposure to agent design/orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, OpenAI/Bedrock Agent SDKs, CrewAI or AutoGen desirable. Education Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology. jobs.title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation
jobs.location: Bangalore - Manyata Tech Park Road · India
jobs.description: Organization: At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. Job Title: Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation Location: Bangalore Business & Team: ASB is one of New Zealand’s leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB — you will build and lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB’s leadership in New Zealand; India’s job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration. Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations — cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India. You will lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability — engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent — organised into squads that sit inside ASB’s tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies. Impact & Contribution: As Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB’s modernisation portfolio — SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate — together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to. Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains — one that measurably accelerates ASB’s modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence. Roles & Responsibilities: Lead India’s engineering capability across core banking, cards, payments, Pega, data and integration, translating ASB New Zealand’s modernisation roadmap into clear, sequenced delivery plans with measurable outcomes. Build outcome-led engineering squads and chapters integrated with ASB tribes, with clear accountability across software, platform, cloud, data and quality engineering. Set and uphold engineering excellence , embedding cloud-first architecture, API-led and event-driven integration, Golden Pathways, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, security controls and measurable engineering standards. Make automation and quality engineering a core strength , establishing reusable test frameworks and large-scale migration testing to reduce manual regression, accelerate delivery and protect customer outcomes. Drive major modernisation programmes , including SAP TRBK core migration, legacy HOST transformation, Cards Modernisation and enterprise Pega, while managing complex migration, cutover and cross-platform dependencies. Build a resilient, always-on payments capability spanning domestic and cross-border payments, real-time processing, switching, settlement, reconciliation, observability and incident readiness. Lead AI-powered engineering adoption , using generative and agentic AI for software development, testing, legacy comprehension, migration, knowledge discovery and operational support, with strong governance, responsible-use guardrails and measurable benefits. Own the India engineering operating model , including resilience, security, regulatory readiness, cost, risk, talent and capability building, while creating a high-performance culture and strong partnership across India and New Zealand. Essential Skills: 15–18+ years of hands-on technology and engineering experience, built on a genuine engineering foundation rather than a purely programme or delivery-management career path. You should still be credible in an architecture or design review, able to read a solution design critically, and able to challenge an engineering or vendor decision on its technical merits. Deep, demonstrable delivery experience in at least one of: SAP core banking modernisation (TRBK or equivalent), Cards Modernisation, Payments, or enterprise Pega — evidenced by systems you have taken to production, not programmes you have governed. jobs.title: Chargeback Senior Supervisor
jobs.description: The Fraud Operations Sr Supervisor provides operational/service leadership and direction to a medium sized team). Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge through provision of value-added perspectives or advisory services. May contribute to the development of new techniques and procedures within area of expertise. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Generally, has responsibility for volume, quality, and timeliness of end results. Work generally affects own team as well as other closely related work teams. Full supervisory responsibility, ensuring motivation and development of team through professional leadership to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations as well as direction of daily tasks and responsibilities. Responsibilities: Lead and develop a medium sized team of Fraud Agents and ensure they consistently meet performance metrics and provide effective customer service while making the proper risk assessments for Citi’s clients Manages department projects/processes, monitors and analyzes changes in Fraud trends/call volumes, and provides evaluative judgment based on analysis of factual information in variable and unique situations. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge of concepts and procedures within own area to resolve issues and minimize Fraud Loss Directly impacts their area through shared responsibility for delivery of end results and contribution to planning and formulation of procedures; influences resource planning. Persuades and influences others through strong communication and diplomacy skills Develop leaders and their skill set and provide growth opportunities through guidance and mentorship in conjunction with succession planning Evaluate team’s performance and makes recommendations for staffing, pay increases, promotions, terminations, staffing, etc. Create and execute realistic action steps and timelines for the team with a strict attention to details and performance Drive organizational change through innovation and process improvement, eliminating friction points for team Achieve team performance excellence to ensure high quality and high-volume productivity Recruit, hire and build a team of highly productive candidates through coaching, collaboration, and motivation of staff Fulfilling the clients’ necessities while providing an exceptional client experience is the expected behavior from all our employees and it will be measured by specific metrics. Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards. Independently exercise judgement and decision-making in managing day-to-day responsibilities, including evaluating complex situations, resolving issues, and determining appropriate courses of action. Drive and influence delivery of work within area of responsibility, contributing to operational priorities and ensuring progress against timelines. Will be accountable for delivery outcomes, including quality and timelines, and may have a measurable impact on business results within scope. In addition, will provide oversight on execution by reviewing outputs, guiding approach where required, and addressing gaps to ensure delivery meets expected standards. Take ownership of decisions and deliverables within remit, applying analytical thinking and professional expertise to solve problems and ensure effective outcomes. Support execution of business decisions within the function by translating direction into actionable steps and ensuring effective follow‑through. Address non‑routine situations and practical challenges by applying judgement to identify solutions or take decisions within scope. Will support effective functioning of the business area by ensuring processes are implemented consistently and outputs meet expected standards. Operate across varied and evolving situations, exercising discretion to respond to changing requirements and priorities, while ensuring reliability, timeliness, and quality in execution within defined scope. Applies domain expertise and advanced analytical capability to deliver outputs aligned with established standards and professional benchmarks. Evaluate business requirements by analyzing complex issues, forming well‑reasoned views, and recommending practical, implementable solutions. Apply structured thinking, analytical rigor, and creativity in approaching work, particularly in situations where standard methodologies may require refinement. Exercise sound professional judgement in interpreting requirements and determining appropriate courses of action, taking into account the broader business context and potential implications. Review and oversee work deliverables, providing guidance, feedback and direction to the team ensure outputs are accurate, complete and aligned with requirements. US Retail Banking experience with focus on Fraud Operations, Credit Card domain and Card Process Fraud Operations. Advanced Excel, Power BI, Lean Certification Proficient in Microsoft Office Comprehensive knowledge of Dispute process Ability to work unsupervised and apply problem solve capabilities Ability to work occasional weekends to support Pega releases and COB testing • Working knowledge of Pega and/or G36 functionality, Continuity of Business (CoB) testing, and creating and resolving Trust Receipts (TR’s) Demonstrated analytical skills Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills Qualifications: Overall Work experience 11 to 15 years

Desired Qualifications: Automation framework (data driven, hybrid and behavior driven development concepts), design and enhancements Cucumber/BDD – based frameworks Selenium with Java – Junit/TestNG framework in Eclipse IDE HP UFT Playwright Version control repo like GITHUB and SVN Test scheduling and execution on Jenkins, etc. HP-QC/ALM, TFS, JIRA or a relevant defect management tool Software testing and automated test techniques with a strong focus on quality thorough the entire software development cycle Payments testing, Payment investigations, wire transfers, ACH payments, Real time payments and payment product testing Advanced knowledge and understanding of test plans, test cases, test procedures, test scripts, and expected results Hands on expertise with test management tools like JIRA, ALM, Confluence etc… Experience in User Acceptance development & implementation Relevant industry certification such as, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CBCP, ITIL, ISTQB, PMP or other specialized IT certifications preferred Posting End Date: 18 Nov 2026 *Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.
